name: LITALICO Inc.
summary: LITALICO Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the employment support, child welfare, platform, and overseas businesses in Japan and the United States. The company offers LITALICO Junior, a preschool and learning support classes for children with developmental and learning disabilities; LITALICO Wonder, an IT and manufacturing classroom; LITALICO Life, a life planning consultation and workshop; LITALICO Development Navi, a developmental disability portal site; LITALICO Developmental Characteristics Test, an online personality assessment service; and LITALICO High School, a correspondence high school support school. It also provides LITALICO Works, a job transition support service …
